exceptions.id: The advisory identifier, in any of its forms: the EEF-CVE id, the CVE id or the GHSA id. The gate matches all three.
exceptions.package: The package the advisory is against, as the lockfile names it.
exceptions.reason: Why the advisory is accepted, in one or two sentences. This is the audit trail.
exceptions.accepted_by: Who accepted it. A person, not a team alias.
exceptions.expires_on: The date the exception stops being honoured, as YYYY-MM-DD. An expired exception refuses the build: the advisory has to be fixed, or the exception has to be renewed with a new reason.
